title: Default installed-wheel test requires live package-index access
reasoning: The normal test suite builds a wheel in an isolated PEP 517 environment while explicitly removing offline controls and forbidding --no-index. Pip must obtain the exactly pinned setuptools and wheel distributions from an index unless they happen to be cached, making otherwise local tests fail in offline, restricted, or transient-network environments.
reproduction: Run pytest tests/test_installed_cli.py with an empty pip cache and network access disabled.
recommendation: Move the network-backed build into an explicitly selected integration lane, or supply a checked/verified local wheelhouse and build with --no-index --find-links so the default suite is deterministic.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The argument test enforces the network-dependent behavior instead of exercising an offline build path.
suggestedRegressionTest: Run _build_wheel with an empty cache, disabled index access, and a local wheelhouse containing the pinned build requirements; assert the wheel builds successfully without network access.
minimumFixScope: Update tests/test_installed_cli.py and the test dependency provisioning or CI configuration to separate or eliminate package-index access in the default test command.
